decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (284|004|F 001, 284|004|F 002, 284|004|F 003, 284|004|F 004, 284|004|F 005, 284|004|F 006 and 284|004|F 007 [received on 14 March 2018]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - The extension hereby approved shall be used solely as part of the house known as 32 Finch Road, Feltham and shall not be occupied as a separate dwelling nor used for business purposes and the premises shall not be used as a house in multiple occupation, including any use within Class C4 of The Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) or such other legislation as may subsequently supersede it.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension with roof windows and erection of a two storey side extension to the house
